name: Cheat Item Kanrikyoku no Oshigoto EX
original_name: Cheat Item Kanrikyoku no Oshigoto EX
overview: A rookie joins a shadowy organization that rescues girls victimized by villains with hypnosis-based abilities, only to discover that his senpai quietly encourages him to sexually assault the unconscious victims during the “brainwashing” process — since their memories will be wiped anyway, the crimes effectively never happened. The rookie embraces this corruption, raping helpless victims under the guise of rehabilitation, and when his senpai falls prey to a submission hypnosis trap, he violates her for hours rather than helping her. After brainwashing her back to normal with no memory of the assault, he continues working alongside her, harboring a twisted obsession while outwardly playing the loyal subordinate.
